candidate.design: ServerDuplex.writeMessage tried transport.writeResponseParts with a stack five-byte gRPC prefix and the caller payload, then copied only an unsent suffix into PendingMessage when an early peer response interrupted the write.

benchmark_method.schedule: five ABBA rounds; baseline, candidate, candidate, baseline
benchmark_method.host: shared host with unrelated load; no CPU pinning
benchmark_method.metric: ns_per_roundtrip from the benchmark result record

results.candidate_wins: 0/10; every candidate sample exceeded every baseline sample
results.conclusion: The borrowed write removed the payload-sized staging allocation and copy, but the extra five-byte DATA frame and the two separate response-data write calls cost more than the removed memory traffic on this workload.

correctness.focused_test: a 100,000-byte server duplex response passed and a counting allocator observed zero allocations at or above the payload size
correctness.note: the correctness test was removed together with the rejected implementation

resolution: The source change and its test were reverted. The accepted ordinary unary prefix-slice path from commit 0e1cef27 is unaffected because it writes prefix and body as one ordered slice burst rather than two separate response-data calls.
